summary: Z Squared Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Paradox Data, LLC from Seller Paradox Infrastructure LLC. Consideration consists of 5,000 shares of newly designated Series A Convertible Preferred Stock with $1,000 stated value per share ($5,000,000 aggregate), plus up to $20,000,000 in milestone payments payable in additional preferred shares upon achieving request-for-service and energization milestones up to 150 MW. Total consideration could reach $25,000,000 if all milestones achieved. Series A preferred accrues 8.0% dividends paid quarterly. Transaction restructured from majority to 100% acquisition. Watch for closing conditions, milestone achievement timing, and conversion/dividend terms affecting dilution.
